name: longstone-vscode
description: Read-only inspector for Longstone agent memories anchored on Base Sepolia, plus an MCP provider that gives Copilot Chat the Longstone memory tools.

longstone.rpcUrl.markdownDescription: Base Sepolia JSON-RPC endpoint. `https://` is required; plain `http://` is accepted only for loopback hosts (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1).

longstone.registryAddress.patternErrorMessage: Must be 0x followed by 40 hex characters.
longstone.registryAddress.markdownDescription: MemoryRegistry contract address. The registry is immutable: an upgrade is a new address, never a proxy.

longstone.ipfsGateway.markdownDescription: IPFS gateway used to fetch content bytes for verification. `https://` is required; loopback `http://` is allowed for local development.

longstone.hisaishiUrl.markdownDescription: Optional Longstone gateway (hisaishi) base URL. When set, content is fetched by digest through it; direct IPFS retrieval by derived CID stays the fallback. `https://` is required; loopback `http://` is allowed. Leave empty to use IPFS only.

longstone.allowWriteTools.markdownDescription: Expose the Longstone MCP **write** tools (`memory_put`, `memory_retract`, `memory_acl`) to MCP hosts. Off by default: the provider then registers `memory_get`, `memory_verify` and `memory_stage_status` only. This is a user (application) setting, so a workspace cannot enable write mode. Write tools still need `LONGSTONE_KEY` in the VS Code environment; this extension never stores keys.

scripts.verify:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm run assert:manifest && pnpm run audit:bundle
